name: [UPDATE🛢️] Slap Battles👏
desc: A game about slapping people into oblivion using different gloves with unique abilities. This game is very chaotic, so don't be surprised if you spot someone complaining about some glove that I'm pretty sure originated from hell itself. You earn slaps when slapping people, which are used to unlock new gloves. Gloves have abilities, some are passive, others are activated by pressing "E" (mobile players have a button). Shift lock is recommended. ANY FORM OF EXPLOITING/HACKING WILL RESULT IN A PERMANENT BAN - don't risk it 😡😡😡😡😡😡 Credit to DM DOKU, Desolo Zantas and Tim Haywood for creating several songs used.
